topArticle.title: Landslide at waste mound in Guinea capital kills 30, government says
topArticle.description:
Dump site in Conakry, which minister had just promised to move, collapsed after heavy rain in west African state
A ⁠landslide at a huge waste dump in Guinea’s capital has killed 30 people, the government said on Sunday, after heavy rains overnight prompted it to ⁠collapse, engulfing nearby tents and shacks.
The incident occurred less than a week after the government announced plans to close the ⁠site and relocate the waste because of the threat it posed, especially during the rainy season, which causes landslides and fatal flash ⁠floods each year in crowded, underdeveloped cities across parts of West Africa.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: ギニア首都の廃棄物集積場で地滑り、30人死亡と政府発表

topArticle.title: US deports 20 people to Liberia, the first of 1,200 migrants under Trump deal
topArticle.description:
Agreement is among largest third-country deportations driven by Trump administration’s immigration crackdown 
Twenty deportees from the United States arrived in Liberia on Thursday, as part of a new agreement that will see the west African country receive as many as 1,200 people under the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown.
The group arrived at the Roberts international airport outside the capital, Monrovia. The Liberia-US agreement is one of the largest third-country deportation arrangements pursued by the administration since Trump returned to office last year.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: 米国、トランプ政権の合意に基づき移民1,200人のうち最初の20人をリベリアに送還

topArticle.title: More than 100 dead after goldmine collapses in Central African Republic
topArticle.description:
The collapse was caused by a landslide, while local officials say the death toll is likely to rise as recovery efforts continue
More than 100 people have died after an artisanal goldmine at a small village in western Central African Republic (CAR) caved in due to a landslide, local officials and aid workers said on Wednesday.
The landslide happened on Tuesday afternoon in the village of Zamboye, about 50km (31 miles) from the town of Baboua and close to the border of Cameroon. Footage on social media appeared to show an avalanche of sand descend on a group of people, likely the miners, and cover them.
 Continue reading...

topArticle.title: Ecuador intelligence chief and five Americans killed in Kenya helicopter crash

topArticle.title: Spain to allow 500 children in Ceuta to go to mainland in immigration U-turn
topArticle.description:
Madrid government changes stance after previously saying anyone who entered territory illegally would be sent back
The Spanish government has U-turned and said it will allow 500 migrant children in Ceuta to relocate to the mainland.
The majority of the estimated 70,000 people who crossed into Ceuta – a Spanish territory on the coast of north Africa – on 30 July have returned to Morocco. However, under Spanish law, the state has a duty of care to young, unaccompanied migrants until they reach the age of 18.
 Continue reading...

topArticle.title: Messi's most iconic moments as he ponders retirement
topArticle.description: As Lionel Messi considers his footballing future following the death of his father, BBC Sport looks back at some of his most iconic moments.
topArticle.titleJa: メッシ引退熟考、キャリアの象徴的瞬間
topArticle.summary: リオネル・メッシが父親の死後、自身のサッカーの将来について熟考する中、彼のキャリアの象徴的な瞬間を振り返る。

topArticle.title: Rumours swirled after a Vietnamese teen was run over - then came a stunning admission
topArticle.description: Confirmation of the circumstances around Do Ngoc Phuong Thuy's death have only spurred more questions.
topArticle.titleJa: ベトナムの10代の若者がひき逃げされた後、噂が飛び交い、その後驚くべき告白があった
topArticle.summary: ベトナム人少女ドー・ゴック・フオン・トゥイさんの死を巡る状況が確認された後も、更なる疑問が提起され、様々な憶測が飛び交っています。

topArticle.title: Hong Kong's Tiananmen activists convicted in national security trial
topArticle.description: Three activists were accused of inciting others to subvert state power under the China-introduced law.

topArticle.summary: 香港の活動家3名が中国導入の国家安全法に基づき、国家政権転覆扇動の罪で有罪判決を受けました。これは香港の政治的自由に対する大きな影響を示しています。

topArticle.title: Nanda Malini, one of Sri Lanka's best known voices of protest, dies at 82
topArticle.description: Once banned from national airwaves, Nanda Malini was known for her songs about social justice.
topArticle.titleJa: スリランカの著名な抗議の声、ナンダ・マリニ氏が82歳で死去
topArticle.summary: スリランカで社会正義を訴える歌で知られ、かつて国営放送で禁止された歌手ナンダ・マリニ氏が82歳で亡くなりました。

topArticle.title: WTO panel issues report regarding Turkish measures on EVs and other types of vehicles
topArticle.description: On 28 July, the WTO circulated the panel report in the case brought by China in "Türkiye — Measures Concerning Electric Vehicles and Other Types of Vehicles from China" (DS629).
topArticle.titleJa: WTOパネル、トルコによるEVなどの車両に関する措置について報告書を発行
topArticle.summary: WTOは中国が提起した、トルコによる電気自動車など中国製車両への措置に関するパネル報告書を回覧した。

topArticle.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
topArticle.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
topArticle.titleJa: リトアニア、途上国および後発開発途上国の貿易スキル向上支援に3万ユーロを拠出
topArticle.summary: リトアニアは2026年に3万ユーロを拠出し、途上国の政府職員向け貿易研修プログラムを支援。WTO関連知識の深化を促す。

topArticle.title: Uzbekistan reaffirms 2026 WTO accession goal, thanks members for continuing engagement
topArticle.description: Uzbekistan reaffirmed its determination to complete its WTO accession process within 2026 at a meeting of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan on 27 and 28 July, soon after its last meeting in March. The head of Uzbekistan's delegation, Chief Negotiator Azizbek Urunov, stressed that maintaining a strong pace of engagement and addressing members' remaining concerns will be critical to bringing the accession process to a successful conclusion.
topArticle.titleJa: ウズベキスタン、2026年までのWTO加盟目標を再確認し、継続的な関与に感謝
topArticle.summary: ウズベキスタンは7月の作業部会で、2026年までのWTO加盟完了目標を再確認し、継続的な関与と懸念事項への対応の重要性を強調した。
